classes.style: Behavior toggle, dual-target (claude-code + claude-ai), built from a canonical prompt.md.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.description: Facilitated brainstorming skill with adaptive technique sequencing.

skills.name: contre-expertise
skills.description: Critical, sourced counter-assessment of a working method: falsifiable propositions, multi-agent deep research, adversarial verification, and a capped action plan.

skills.name: feature-torture
skills.description: Pressure-test one roadmap feature per session and emit a 500-900-word decision report (verdict + ADR + adjacency + spec stub).

skills.name: market-strategist
skills.description: Strategic advisor for market analysis, positioning, traction, pitch and project communication — it fills the framework and lets you react, drawing on a library of 24 well-known and lesser-known frameworks.

skills.name: pair-with-me
skills.description: Work one issue as an adversarial pair, not a delegation — reduce the triple debt (technical, cognitive, intent) and keep the human the author of their own system.

skills.name: redaction
skills.description: Boucle d'édition critique pour écrits longs (articles, billets, essais).

skills.name: rhetorical-analysis
skills.description: Analyse rhétorique et épistémologique d'articles, discours et textes argumentatifs.

skills.name: meeting-screenshot-extractor
skills.description: Builds a CLI Python tool to automatically extract relevant screenshots from a meeting video, using a transcript and user-defined topics.

skills.name: show
skills.description: Visual grammar for anything written for a reader: which visual the content calls for, how it renders or falls back on each target, and the page rules that make it scannable.

skills.name: flair
skills.description: End substantive answers with a short learning-flavored anecdote stack just above the TL;DR.
skills.install: clone the repo, then ./install.sh (Claude Code) or paste claude-ai/ into a claude.ai custom style

skills.name: glance
skills.description: Optimize answers for at-a-glance readability — scannable shape first, prose only as fallback.
skills.install: clone the repo, then ./install.sh (Claude Code) or paste claude-ai/ into a claude.ai custom style

skills.name: transpeak
skills.description: Answer in code rather than prose wherever the content has a shape — types and expressions instead of paragraphs.
skills.install: clone the repo, then ./install.sh (Claude Code) or paste claude-ai/ into a claude.ai custom style
